decision: D-032: polfer approved RC-12 (drafts/RC-12.md of the OVPR planning folder, directive-ovpr-planning-202611) on 2026-11-18, with one change: customer-facing messages must not use 'OVPR' or other internal terms. The old-project message is: "This project uses an older version of Directive that isn't installed. Run `npm install` (or `pnpm install`) to keep using it, or run `directive upgrade` to update." General rule for this initiative: every customer-facing message is short, direct and readable without Directive acronyms. RC-12 lands as its own docs-only PR (#6670) with exactly the approved text, merged by polfer before P1-U2 (#6653) merges.

governingRule.description: OVPR-CHANGE-GATE step 3-4: polfer approves the exact text, then it is recorded (D-002, D-031, D-032)
